incident_text: The river has overflowed and flooded the fields and part of the city.

result.scene_summary: Two satellite images show a river system with several islands and surrounding urban and agricultural areas. The bottom image shows smoke plumes over parts of the landscape.

observations.description: Smoke plumes visible in the lower image over the urban and agricultural areas.
Urban areas labeled as Memphis, West Memphis, Mud Island, and Treasure Island.
Agricultural fields and roads visible in the landscape.
River channels and islands forming part of the landscape.
